official.deadline_note: No separate scholarship deadline is published. Eligibility is tied to the September 2027 or January 2028 postgraduate intake, and the discount is applied at registration with a confirmation communication sent soon after the programme offer.
official.status_note: The University lists the World Changers Glasgow Scholarship for September 2027 / January 2028 entry on its Scholarships & funding site.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The scholarship is published as a £5,000 tuition fee discount; it reduces the tuition fee only.
benefits: Awarded automatically to all eligible applicants
eligibility: Be enrolled on an eligible postgraduate programme for the September 2027 or January 2028 intake

Be a national of one of the eligible countries: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, India, Indonesia, Israel, Jordan, Kenya, Lebanon, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Palestine, Singapore, Syria, Thailand, Vietnam or Yemen
Cannot be combined with another University scholarship
Offer is automatically withdrawn if you are fully funded by an external sponsor
requirements: Meet the entry criteria for one of the listed eligible postgraduate programmes
Hold nationality of one of the 19 eligible countries
Not hold another University of Glasgow scholarship and not be fully funded by an external sponsor
documents: No scholarship-specific documents are required: no additional application is required for the discount
selection_criteria: Automatically awarded to all eligible applicants who meet the entry criteria
coverage: £5,000 tuition fee discount - the published award scope is the tuition fee only
application_method: The tuition fee discount is applied at registration; no additional application is required
A communication confirming the scholarship is sent soon after you receive your programme offer
official.application_route: Apply for an eligible postgraduate programme for September 2027 or January 2028 entry through the University's online application system; eligible applicants receive the tuition fee discount automatically at registration.
official.citizenship_residency: National of one of the 19 eligible countries (Brazil, Chile, Colombia, India, Indonesia, Israel, Jordan, Kenya, Lebanon, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Palestine, Singapore, Syria, Thailand, Vietnam, Yemen) with international fee status.
official.international_eligibility: Open only to nationals of the 19 listed countries assessed at the international fee rate; not available to students with UK fee status.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Enrolment on one of the eligible postgraduate taught programmes listed on the scholarship webpage.
official.description: The World Changers Glasgow Scholarship is a £5,000 tuition fee discount awarded by the University of Glasgow for September 2027 / January 2028 entry to recognise applicants from 19 listed countries. It is awarded automatically to all eligible applicants and cannot be combined with another University scholarship.
official.program_type: University country-specific postgraduate tuition fee discount (automatic award)

verification.notes: Award value (£5,000 tuition fee discount), eligibility, eligible-country list, unlimited awards, application method and exclusion rules were verified on the University of Glasgow's own scholarship and how-to-apply pages. Those pages publish no separate deadline date, English language requirement, award duration or study mode for this scholarship.

applicant_utility.summary: Nationals of India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Brazil, Mexico, Vietnam, Kenya and 11 other listed countries who take up an eligible Glasgow taught master's in September 2027 or January 2028 receive £5,000 off tuition automatically, with no essay, no referee and no separate form. The practical deadline is the programme application date for that intake, since the discount is applied at registration and confirmed by email shortly after your offer. It cannot be stacked with any other University of Glasgow scholarship, and the offer is withdrawn automatically if an external sponsor funds you fully, so compare offers before accepting. Budget for the large remainder of tuition, living costs, flights and visa expenses, none of which this award touches.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Self-funded applicants from the 19 listed countries who want a partial tuition discount on one of Glasgow's eligible taught master's programmes and do not need full living-cost funding.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your nationality appears on the 19-country list and that you will be assessed at the international fee rate
Check that your intended programme appears on the scholarship webpage's eligible-programmes list before applying
Submit the programme application in good time for the September 2027 or January 2028 intake, since the discount follows the offer
Budget for the balance of tuition, living costs, flights, the Student visa fee and the Immigration Health Surcharge
Verify the programme's own entry requirements, including its English language condition, on the programme page
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a programme that is not on the eligible-programmes list, so no discount is applied
Holding or accepting another University of Glasgow scholarship, since awards cannot be combined and only the highest is applied at registration
Being fully funded by an external sponsor, which automatically withdraws the scholarship offer
Assuming the discount covers living costs, flights, visa or health surcharge expenses when it is tuition-only
Losing eligibility by deferring entry, as scholarship offers cannot be deferred
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The majority of the international tuition fee (the £5,000 is a partial discount), plus living costs in Glasgow, flights, the Student visa fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, and the admissions deposit.
document_audit: No scholarship-specific documents, references or personal statement are needed, but the underlying programme application still requires transcripts, degree evidence and proof of English
Keep the confirmation email sent shortly after your programme offer as evidence the discount has been awarded
Check your fee statement at registration to confirm the £5,000 has actually been deducted from tuition
alerts: This is the postgraduate scheme only - do not confuse it with the separate undergraduate World Changers Global Excellence Scholarship
The offer is withdrawn automatically if you are fully funded by an external sponsor
Scholarship offers cannot be deferred; if you delay entry you must re-check eligibility for the next cycle
There is no cap on awards, so there is no competition to beat - eligibility, not merit ranking, decides the outcome
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the online application for an eligible taught master's for September 2027 or January 2028 entry, receive the programme offer, then the discount is applied at registration with a confirming email; no scholarship form exists.
